summary: Backend testing complete - All 50 tests passed (41 existing + 9 new forgot-password/reset-password tests). Comprehensive testing of forgot-password dev-mode flow with 6-digit code generation, reset-password with code validation, single-use tokens, expiration, and email enumeration prevention.
critical_code_review_comments: ✅ POST /api/auth/forgot-password with existing email returns {ok: true, dev_code: '6-digit string', message}
✅ POST /api/auth/forgot-password with unknown email returns {ok: true, dev_code: null, message} (no email enumeration)
✅ dev_code is exactly 6 digits (zero-padded if needed, e.g., '091861')
✅ Reset tokens stored hashed in password_reset_tokens collection with 1-hour TTL
✅ POST /api/auth/reset-password with correct email+code+new_password succeeds and changes password
✅ After successful reset, old password no longer works for login; new password works
✅ POST /api/auth/reset-password with wrong code returns 400 'Invalid code'
✅ POST /api/auth/reset-password with already-used code returns 400 (tokens marked used=true, single-use)
✅ POST /api/auth/reset-password before any forgot-password request returns 400 'No reset code has been requested'
✅ POST /api/auth/reset-password validates password length (min 6 chars, returns 422 validation error)
✅ Requesting new forgot-password code deletes prior pending tokens for that email (clean state)
✅ Timezone handling correct: expires_at properly compared with timezone-aware datetime
✅ All existing auth flows still pass (register, login, me, users, matches, lineup, result)
✅ No regressions in existing functionality (41 existing tests still pass)
seed_data_creation: Tests create unique users per test run using timestamp-based email addresses (TEST_*_{timestamp}@clubdodo.com). Admin user (admin@clubdodo.com / dodo2026) is seeded on startup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Forgot-password dev-mode flow fully implemented and tested. POST /api/auth/forgot-password returns dev_code directly in response (no email integration). Codes are 6 digits, stored hashed with 1-hour TTL, single-use (marked used=true after reset). Requesting new code deletes prior pending tokens. Unknown emails return dev_code=null (no enumeration). All existing functionality still working (no regressions).
